core_obligations: The proof is the author's own, headed explicitly Proof of Lemma lem:bulletstable, and it works with the associated graded object of a zeta-bullet-polystable module with respect to the Jordan-Holder filtration (proof lines 1963-2026).

The stability input: the author uses the author's criterion for the surjectivity of the maps beta_i (label lem:betasurj) at the relevant place in the argument (proof lines 1963-2026; the label is declared as a non-load-bearing navigation pointer below).

The face argument: the proof passes through the faces of the stability parameter and the description of the strata of the moduli space to conclude that the graded object is a sum of simple modules for the subgraph extended by zero, which is the assertion of the statement.
The comparison with the author's earlier criterion for the non-vanishing of the regular part, label thm:CB, is what allows the author to recognise which of the summands can occur.
proof_roadmap: 作者用自己的显式标题 Proof of Lemma lem:bulletstable 开头，因此配对没有歧义。
论证沿 zeta-稳定性参数的 face 结构与多项稳定模的 Jordan-Holder 分次展开，再用 lem:betasurj 的映射满性判据与 thm:CB 的非空判据识别哪些单模可以出现，最后得到关联分次是若干单模的直和。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the structural lemma on the associated graded object of a module stable for a generic parameter (author Lemma at source lines 1921-1936, label lem:bulletstable). Its proof (source lines 1963-2026) is the longest of the author's explicitly headed proofs in that section of the paper: it runs through the face structure of the stability parameters and the Jordan-Holder filtration of a polystable module and uses the author's earlier surjectivity criterion for the maps beta_i together with the author's criterion for the non-vanishing of the regular part to identify which simple modules may appear in the graded object. The statement is one of the two inputs that the author's branching theorem needs about the strata, which is why its proof is written out in full. H2.
